text:
Predicates:
Eastern(x) ::: x is an Eastern wild turkey.
Osceola(x) ::: x is an Osceola wild turkey.
Gould(x) ::: x is a Gould’s wild turkey.
Merriam(x) ::: x is a Merriam’s wild turkey.
RioGrande(x) ::: x is a Rio Grande wild turkey.
Ocellated(x) ::: x is an Ocellated wild turkey.
Tom ::: the individual Tom.
WildTurkey(x) ::: x is a wild turkey.
Premises:
¬Eastern(Tom) ∧ ¬Osceola(Tom) ∧ (¬Gould(Tom) ∨ ¬Merriam(Tom) ∨ ¬RioGrande(Tom)) ∧ WildTurkey(Tom) ::: Tom is not an Eastern wild turkey, not an Osceola wild turkey, not a Gould's, Merriam's, or Rio Grande wild turkey, and is a wild turkey.
Conclusion:
Eastern(Tom) ::: Tom is an Eastern wild turkey.
